scientificQuestion: Does restricting the already-frozen V147 audio-driven +/-1 pitch overrides to accepted-baseline singleton onsets avoid the reference-free polyphonic-mixture failure mechanism while preserving the strong structural invariants of family #10?
hypothesis: Independent note-wise pitch overrides are structurally unreliable in polyphonic onset mixtures because each note is evaluated against onset-local mixed-spectrum evidence without a joint chord-coherence model. Therefore polyphonic onsets should fail closed to the accepted family #10 baseline; only singleton onsets may inherit an already-frozen V147 override.

interpretation: The failure is not primarily explained by marginal gate crossings: only 30 of 247 changes were within 1 dB of any frozen V147 decision gate.
The failure is not primarily explained by octave weighting: only 2 of 247 selected winners depended on the octave bonus to beat the fundamental-only winner.
Change incidence rises materially with polyphonic onset size, especially at the onset level.
New duplicated-pitch identities provide a concrete chord-coherence failure mode; 17 of 19 occurred when a changed note moved onto an unchanged simultaneous pitch.
These observations are reference-free mechanism evidence only; no individual substitution has been labeled correct or incorrect.

singleFrozenConstructionPolicy.name: accepted-onset-singleton-only-v147-projection
rule: Group the accepted baseline by exact (measure, step) onset.
If and only if the accepted onset contains exactly one event AND the corresponding immutable V147 decision has changed=true, copy that event's already-materialized canonical V147 candidate row.
For every polyphonic accepted onset, preserve every accepted family #10 event exactly regardless of V147 decision evidence.
For unchanged singleton decisions, preserve the accepted family #10 event exactly.
Do not recalculate pitch evidence, alter any V147 decision threshold, alter octave weight, or infer a new fingering.
Do not apply pitch-class, register, string, section, score-margin, fundamental-margin, or any other post-hoc filter. Singleton-vs-polyphonic is the only construction discriminator.

requiredConstructionGates: accepted baseline identity reverified before reading V147 projection inputs
V147 candidate and decisions byte SHA256 identities reverified
exactly 1144 canonical events and 113 generated measures
exactly 106 changed events / 106 changed onsets versus accepted family #10
every changed accepted onset has cardinality exactly one
every polyphonic accepted onset is byte-equivalent at canonical event level to family #10
every changed singleton row is exactly the corresponding immutable V147 candidate row after canonicalization
all timing and protected non-position metadata remain invariant versus accepted family #10
all string/fret/MIDI positions satisfy the frozen V143 render contract
deterministic replay produces identical canonical event SHA256
PDF event fidelity equals 1.0 and PDF event SHA equals candidate event SHA
postConstructionBoundary: After exactly one immutable V148 candidate is constructed, hash-bound, replay-verified, PDF-fidelity-verified, and durably preserved, STOP. Any Gold/reference-facing comparison requires a new explicit one-use scoring authorization. No score is authorized by this preregistration.
